description: This file defines types, constants, and functions for managing OpenAI response payload policies, including parsing configuration, determining policy settings, and applying policies to payload objects.

methods.name: parsePositiveInteger
methods.description: Parses a value as a positive integer, accepting both number and string inputs.

methods.name: resolveOpenAIResponsesCompactThreshold
methods.description: Calculates the compact threshold based on the model's context window.

methods.name: shouldEnableOpenAIResponsesServerCompaction
methods.description: Determines whether server compaction should be enabled based on explicit store setting, provider, and extra parameters.

methods.name: stripDisabledOpenAIReasoningPayload
methods.description: Removes reasoning payloads with 'none' effort or unsupported 'effort: none' from the payload object.

methods.name: resolveOpenAIResponsesPayloadPolicy
methods.description: Generates a payload policy object based on model and options, considering capabilities and configuration.

methods.name: applyOpenAIResponsesPayloadPolicy
methods.description: Applies a given payload policy to a payload object, modifying or removing fields accordingly.
